subject: sources.yaml: link-only rows for ACOG/AAP/Endocrine Society/WPATH/ACR/AAD/AAOS/NCCN/AUA?
body:
seg23-f (S23-F: skin, MSK, pregnancy, reproductive) needs link-only `sources` rows for professional-society guidelines, to cite in `furtherReading` and item `references`. Today sources.yaml has statpearls, cdc-guidelines, uspstf, medlineplus-* and the USMLE rows, but no obstetrics, pediatrics or rheumatology society.

Proposal: add these rows to config/sources.yaml, all `license: link-only`, with allow_copy/modify/commercial/ai_ingest false, and `verified: false` until each site's terms are read. Never quote; restate in our own words.
- `acog`: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (https://www.acog.org)
- `aap`: American Academy of Pediatrics (https://www.aap.org)
- `endocrine-society`: Endocrine Society clinical practice guidelines (https://www.endocrine.org)
- `wpath`: WPATH Standards of Care v8 (https://www.wpath.org)
- `acr-rheum`: American College of Rheumatology guidelines (https://rheumatology.org)
- `aad`: American Academy of Dermatology guidelines (https://www.aad.org)
- `aaos`: American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons guidelines (https://www.aaos.org)
- `nccn`: NCCN guidelines (https://www.nccn.org) (patient-facing landing pages only)
- `aua`: American Urological Association guidelines (https://www.auanet.org)

Other authors probably need the same kind of row (ADA, ACC/AHA, IDSA, ATS), so one shared PR from you may be simplest. Until you decide, I'll cite only the existing rows (statpearls with NBK ids resolved via NCBI E-utilities, cdc-guidelines, uspstf, medlineplus-federal). Afterwards I'll add the society links in a re-import; my ids won't change.
